title: Data Warehousing and Dimensional Modeling
scope: A complete data warehousing and dimensional modeling course covering analytical requirements, grain, facts and dimensions, star schemas, conformed dimensions and bus architecture, slowly changing dimensions, bridge/snapshot patterns, surrogate keys, source profiling, ETL/ELT, CDC, orchestration, physical/columnar design, semantic layers, marts, governance, testing, observability, performance, cloud/lakehouse architecture, migration, and production delivery.
coverage_note: Vendor-neutral dimensional modeling and modern warehouse engineering principles spanning classic Kimball-style patterns, ELT/cloud warehouses, semantic metrics, governance, testing, and lakehouse coexistence
